description: Summary: You will be part of a group practice which sees the entire range of patients, from pediatric to geriatric. Visiting Consultants in other specialties, primarily from University of Alberta academic centres, provide services, either onsite or remotely. For physicians who thrive in the outdoors, Hinton offers an unparalleled opportunity to live and play in one of Canada’s most dramatic settings. Hinton, a gateway to the Rockies, offers endless trails for hiking, mountain biking, and cross-country skiing; Hinton itself has 35 km of groomed trails, while the surrounding area has 300km of groomed trails, making it one of the largest cross-country ski areas in Canada. For downhill enthusiasts, Jasper’s Marmot Basin ski resort, with its 91 runs and highest base elevation of any major Canadian ski area, is only 80 minutes away! And there are no wait lines for the lifts! Finally, if you want varied work, and a busy, interesting practice where you can maximize your income in a location with a low cost of living, Hinton is for you.
